comparison.objective: Candidate screens ceramic media from metal washers; PR reattaches a detached wrist camera to its original robot mount.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual rim grasping, pouring, agitation, and bridge clearing; PR tests tapered-shoe insertion, guide alignment, spring-latch engagement, and support until retention.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% recovery, all washers retained, no loss/damage, and screen release on supports for 3 s; PR requires camera pose within 5 mm/5°, verified channel entry and latch engagement, live frame delivery, and unsupported retention for 2 s.
comparison.reason: Aperture-based granular separation is meaningfully different from guided component insertion and latch verification; earlier PR versions omit some latch detail but later complete specs resolve the comparison.
